Blu-ray players that won't break the bank


Well, it looks like old HD DVD may have lost the race. Which means it's time to turn attention to Blu-ray. Blu-ray players aren't as cheap as HD DVD players, but you can still find them for less than $500. In fact our reviewers have worked long and hard to round up the best five for less than $500. If you do purchase one of these players, pour a little out in memory of HD DVD. Five for less than $500
